falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek/PannotationsSidecarBinary.cs:594; replace FileIOUtils.SafeWriteBytes with a direct File.WriteAllBytes -> green (only deleting the write entirely -> red)
what_it_asserts: After Write, the destination file exists and no sibling .tmp is left behind.
why_weak: Both assertions hold for any write path. Swapping FileIOUtils.SafeWriteBytes (PannotationsSidecarBinary.cs:594) for File.WriteAllBytes leaves the test green, so the HR-12 atomic contract the name claims is not pinned.
proposed_action: Pin the mechanism: pre-create a stale <path>.tmp and assert Write removes it, or assert an existing good file survives when the byte payload build throws mid-write.

falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek/PannotationsSidecarBinary.cs:682; delete the perBlockCap branch -> green (the stream-length branch at :689 still rejects); delete both -> red
what_it_asserts: A spline count of 10001 makes TryRead return false with a reason containing 'spline'.

proposed_action: Assert reason.Contains('exceeds cap') (and the cap value), which only the per-block branch produces.
